sentences.text: Shri Ashish Gupta, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Shri Mukesh Kumawat, learned counsel for the respondent/State.
Heard on the question of admission.
Record of the lower Court be requisitioned.
Also heard on I.A. No.19750/2017, an application for suspension of jail sentence and for grant of bail.

The present petition has been filed against the judgment of conviction dated 13.5.2017 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Sonkatch,
District Dewas in complaint criminal case No.34/11, by which the petitioner has been convicted and sentenced for offence under Sections 7(4) and (2-a) (M) read with Section 16 (1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act for six months R.I. with fine of Rs.1000 and in default one month's imprisonment.

entities.text:
Additional Sessions Judge, Sonkatch,
District Dewas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has argued before this Court that the petitioner is an owner of a small Dhaba and certain items were kept in deep freezer.
It has been stated that the quality of paneer found in the freezer was not found up to the mark, as per the report of the chemical analysis and in those circumstances, he has been convicted.
been argued by learned counsel for the petitioner that the procedure prescribed under the Food Adulteration Act was not followed in the matter and there are a lot of contradictions and omissions.
Learned Govt. Advocate has opposed the application for suspension of sentence.

Considering the averments made in the application and looking to the facts and circumstance of the case, without expressing any opinion of merits of the case, I.A. No.19750/2017 is allowed and it is directed that the substantive jail sentence of the petitioner shall remain suspended and he be released subject to his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court and he shall appear before the Registry of this Court on 15.3.2018 and on all other subsequent dates as may be given in this behalf.
